# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Implemented all four pending budget-remediation amendments in `tank_core`. Producer loss routing now clamps to biomass actually removed instead of uncapped respiration/grazing/senescence requests: `step_daily_plants` proportionally clamps respiration vs. senescence before routing to DOC/DON or detritus, and `step_daily_algae` clamps suspended/periphyton respiration+grazing to available biomass. Periphyton capacity overflow is now treated as an explicit dissolved-organic loss instead of silently disappearing when the post-loss biomass is capped. The nitrifier bookkeeping in `nitrogen_cycle.rs` was reworked so AOB/comammox growth reserves TAN from the matching source pool, NOB growth reserves nitrite instead of ammonia, and each guild now solves oxidation plus assimilatory growth together against source-N and DIC budgets so growth no longer collapses just because the oxidation ceiling would otherwise consume the whole substrate pool. I also added declaration-site doc comments on `nitrogen_budget_components` and `carbon_budget_components` documenting the naming-convention contract behind the structural coverage test. Regression coverage now includes periphyton-cap spill routing, producer-loss clamping, and AOB/NOB/comammox growth-source cases, while the existing budget ledger and full `tank_core` suite continue to pass.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Audited the reviewed amendments against the current algae, plant, nitrogen-cycle, and budget-helper implementations to pinpoint the remaining mass-loss and source-pool bookkeeping gaps.
2. [Completed] Patched producer routing so plant respiration/senescence and algae respiration/grazing only move the biomass actually removed, and routed periphyton capacity overflow into dissolved organics instead of dropping it on the floor.
3. [Completed] Reworked nitrifier growth bookkeeping so AOB/comammox fund growth from TAN, NOB funds growth from nitrite, and each guild solves oxidation plus assimilatory growth against source-N and DIC before applying state deltas; added declaration-site naming-contract docs for canonical budget components.
4. [Completed] Added focused regressions for periphyton overflow, producer loss clamping, and nitrifier growth-source behavior, then ran focused and full-package validation plus clippy.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_core --test budget_tracking` passed (17 tests, including new regressions for periphyton-cap routing and plant/algae loss clamping).
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test cycling` passed (12 tests, including new AOB/NOB/comammox growth-source regressions).
- `cargo test -p tank_core` passed across the full `tank_core` test suite.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings` passed.

## Outstanding Risks

- The canonical-helper coverage guard is now documented, but it remains convention-based rather than reflective. Future explicit N/C-bearing fields with non-standard names still require updating both the component functions and the coverage-rule helpers together.
- Complex multi-process stages such as `system:nitrogen_cycle` still record some budgets from snapshot-derived gross component deltas, so same-component turnover inside one stage can remain collapsed until those stages emit fully explicit source/sink records.
- The new nitrifier source-pool solver fixes the reviewed conservation bug, but it still relies on the current simplified guild-yield model and shared live-biomass stoichiometry. If nitrifier biomass composition or yield semantics change in later phases, the solver and its regression fixtures should be revisited together.
